_doc: The evidence hierarchy and the reading contract, as data. Carried in a prompt these are advisory and deletable; carried here they are read by scripts/verify_reading_contract.py and by every agent before it asserts anything. Ratified by the operator 2026-08-26. D-118.

precedence.what: This ecosystem's own governed files, in the order SESSION_START.md names them.
precedence.rule: Nothing below this tier may contradict it without an RDL entry that says so.

precedence.what: The peer-reviewed and institutional sources this ecosystem has already adopted and cited.
members: the licence and provenance blocks of each axis in data/axes/
precedence.rule: A method claim cites one of these or it is not a method claim.

precedence.what: Sources the decision holder hands over directly in a session.
precedence.rule: Admitted at face value as the operator's own instruction, and written into tier 2 once cited in a landed artefact.
Last resort. Never used to overturn tiers 1 to 3. Every claim taken from here carries its URL and the date it was read.

planes._why: G-01b. Four planes, four different questions, and a value read on one is never evidence about another. L-182 is what it costs to forget which one was read.

artefact.question: what does the index say
artefact.authoritative_reader: read data/qesis_v8.json on disk, or scripts/verify_index.py

evidence.question: what has already gone wrong and what was decided
evidence.authoritative_reader: ops/LESSONS_LEDGER.md via scripts/verify_ledger_singleton.py --json, and ops/RDL_LADDER.json via scripts/rdl.py status

delivery.question: what is on main, what merged, which checks are green
delivery.authoritative_reader: scripts/gh_ops.py proof, or the Chrome bridge against api.github.com and github.com in the operator's own session

serving.question: what is actually being served to a caller right now
serving.authoritative_reader: the Chrome bridge fetching https://qesis-mcp.vercel.app/health against the live origin, or the Vercel API via list_deployments and get_deployment

WebFetch.why: Its own documentation states responses are cached for 15 minutes per URL, and an edge cache can hold a value far longer. A cached response is a proxy for the resource.
WebFetch.evidence: L-182. It returned deployment_commit 24a6a80 while the live origin returned 654c950, and an item was placed on the operator that nobody needed to do.
WebFetch.permitted_use: Reading prose a human will read. Never the source of a value that appears in a report.
WebFetch.if_used_anyway: The value carries the word cached beside it, or it does not appear.

assertion_rule.statement: Every asserted value names its plane and the reader that produced it.
assertion_rule.authority: CLAUDE.md Rule V-1, D-115, D-116 rule 1, D-118.
